claim: Since November 4, 2025 you can add a warm pool to an Auto Scaling group that has a mixed instances policy, when the group uses multiple On-Demand instance types (Spot Instances are still not supported in the warm pool's mixed group).
question: Can an Auto Scaling group with a mixed instances policy have a warm pool, and since when?

values.display: add warm pools to Auto Scaling groups

qualifiers.scope: per Auto Scaling group with a mixed instances policy
qualifiers.condition: the mixed instances policy is On-Demand only

evidence.quote: Your mixed instances policy must be configured for On-Demand instances only when using warm pools.
Warm pools don’t support Spot Instances within mixed instance groups.
Starting today, you can add warm pools to Auto Scaling groups (ASGs) that have mixed instances policies.

evidence.heading: EC2 Auto Scaling announces warm pool support for Auto Scaling groups that have mixed instances policies

note: Older material may say a warm pool cannot be used with a mixed instances policy. GA 2025-11-04, before the 2026-07-15 cutoff. No document-history row found for it. Current truth: ec2-auto-scaling-warm-pool-no-spot-no-weights.
